verdict.rationale: skills.sh CLI explicitly supports installing a skill collection into multiple named agents (e.g., `-a claude-code -a opencode`, `--agent claude-code cursor`) and lists broad support for Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode plus 70+ more, with per-agent directory targeting (`./<agent>/skills/`) and symlink-based single-source-of-truth updates. Cross-agent reuse is also stated in docs ('Build a skill once and use it across any skills-compatible agent'). Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that per-harness instructions actually differ/adapt correctly across agents beyond directory placement, and community commentary raises unanswered concerns about version-pinning/uninstall completeness.
